about: A scroll on a dock icon (docs/adr/0045-app-expose.mdx) after natural scrolling (docs/adr/0042-scrolling.mdx, decision 6), through real libinput: the development compositor's virtual touchpad and wheel mouse (`uinput`), so this scenario runs only that way, as root. The Dock reads the scroll as delivered, as a Mac's does: up (dy below 0) opens App Exposé, down closes it, and which way the hand moves for it is the preference's. At 1.25, in Spanish, with the preferences turned from what the session ships (trackpad_natural_scrolling = false, mouse_natural_scrolling = true): two fingers up open it and down close it; the wheel toward the person opens it and away closes it. Allo's two windows, as in app-expose-gestures, which checks the rest of App Exposé (its flights, the keyboard). Each step checks what the shell's host received (`scroll_input`: every scroll one way, how many), the views App Exposé shows, the keyboard going to it and back (a scroll on the shell is its input, as a press is), and that neither application's React tree hears anything.

steps.name: two fingers moved up on Allo's dock icon: with the trackpad's natural scrolling off they deliver a scroll up (the view following them), and App Exposé opens
two fingers moved down on it: a scroll down, and it closes
the wheel turned a notch toward the person: with the mouse's natural scrolling on, a scroll up (the content following the wheel down), and App Exposé opens
a notch away from the person: a scroll down, and it closes
